name: Oh Hell
tagline: Hands grow and shrink each round. Bid exactly right — no more, no less.
rulesSummary: Everyone plays for themselves. Bid exactly how many tricks you'll take: no more, no less.
The first deal is 10 cards each (fewer if the lobby says so), then one fewer each deal down to 1, then back up.
The next card is turned up: its suit is trumps.
Bidding starts left of the dealer. The dealer bids last and can't make the bids add up to the number of tricks, so someone always misses.
The player left of the dealer leads. Follow suit if you can; if not, play anything. The highest trump wins, or else the highest card of the suit led.
Score 1 point per trick, plus 10 if you took exactly your bid. If only exact bids score (a lobby option), a miss scores nothing.
Highest total after the last deal wins.
Six players: the first deal is 8 cards at most.
Seven players: the first deal is 7 cards at most.
